an10.219:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave sañcetanikānaṃ kammānaṃ katānaṃ upacitānaṃ appaṭisaṃviditvā byantibhāvaṃ vadāmi
an10.219:1.2: tañca kho diṭṭheva dhamme upapajje vā apare vā pariyāye
an10.219:1.3: na tvevāhaṃ bhikkhave sañcetanikānaṃ kammānaṃ katānaṃ upacitānaṃ appaṭisaṃviditvā dukkhassantakiriyaṃ vadāmi
an10.219:2.1: sakho so bhikkhave ariyasāvako evaṃvigatābhijjho vigatabyāpādo asammūḷho sampajāno patissato mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati
an10.219:3.2: pubbe kho me idaṃ cittaṃ parittaṃ hoti abhāvitaṃ etarahi pana me idaṃ cittaṃ appamāṇaṃ subhāvitaṃ yaṃ kho pana kiñci pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ na taṃ tatrāvasissati na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhati
an10.219:4.2: daharatagge ce ayaṃ kumāro mettācetovimuttiṃ bhāveyya apinu kho pāpakammaṃ kareyyāti.
an10.219:5.1: akarontaṃ kho pana pāpakammaṃ apinu kho dukkhaṃ phuseyyāti.
an10.219:5.3: akarontañhi bhante pāpakammaṃ kuto dukkhaṃ phusissatīti.
an10.219:6.1: bhāvetabbā kho panāyaṃ bhikkhave mettācetovimutti itthiyā vā purisena vā
an10.219:6.2: itthiyā vā bhikkhave purisassa vā nāyaṃ kāyo ādāya gamanīyo
an10.219:6.5: yaṃ kho me idaṃ kiñci pubbe iminā karajakāyena pāpakammaṃ kataṃ sabbantaṃ idha vedaniyaṃ
an10.219:6.7: evaṃ bhāvitā kho bhikkhave mettācetovimutti anāgāmitāya saṃvattati idha paññassa bhikkhuno uttariṃ vimuttiṃ appaṭivijjhatoti.
an10.219:7.3: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ
an10.219:7.4: iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati
an10.219:8.2: pubbe kho me idaṃ cittaṃ parittaṃ hoti abhāvitaṃ etarahi pana me idaṃ cittaṃ appamāṇaṃ subhāvitaṃ yaṃ kho pana kiñci pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ na taṃ tatrāvasissati na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhati
an10.219:9.2: daharatagge ce ayaṃ kumāro upekkhācetovimuttiṃ bhāveyya apinu kho pāpakammaṃ kareyyāti.
an10.219:10.1: akarontaṃ kho pana pāpakammaṃ apinu kho dukkhaṃ phuseyyāti.
an10.219:10.3: akarontañhi bhante pāpakammaṃ kuto dukkhaṃ phusissatīti.
